verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API v1 reference at /api-reference and GraphQL management pages with cURL and GraphQL examples, so a browsable API reference with copyable examples exists. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive try-it console or examples that run in the browser, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API playground, runnable (executable) examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent/hands-on corroboration.
